grammar.pattern: 不A不B：不慌不忙 / 不大不小
grammar.purpose: Recognize a fixed or licensed paired expression
grammar.explanation: 不慌不忙 means unhurried; 不大不小 describes an intermediate suitable size. These paired expressions differ in meaning and are not a productive instruction to combine any two verbs with 不. Learn the whole expression and its context. 不大不小 does not provide an exact measurement.

examples.zh: 她不慌不忙地核对地址。
examples.py: tā bù huāng bù máng de hé duì dì zhǐ .

examples.zh: 这个袋子不大不小，装这些书正合适。
examples.py: zhè gè dài zi bù dà bù xiǎo , zhuāng zhè xiē shū zhèng hé shì .
examples.en: This bag is neither large nor small; it suits these books.

examples.zh: 不慌不忙，不代表不认真。
examples.py: bù huāng bù máng , bù dài biǎo bù rèn zhēn .
examples.en: Being unhurried does not imply lack of care.

commonMistakes.why: The expression describes unhurried manner, not lack of care.

grammar.purpose: Concede a positive point before a limitation
grammar.explanation: 好是好，不过地点没确认 concedes goodness and then limits the endorsement. 是 repeats the acknowledged predicate; 就是/不过 introduces the reservation. The pattern is not an overall refusal by itself; the following clause supplies the actual problem.

examples.zh: 好是好，不过地点还没确认。
examples.py: hǎo shì hǎo , bù guò dì diǎn hái méi què rèn .
examples.en: It is good, but the location is still unconfirmed.

examples.zh: 简单是简单，就是少了时间。
examples.py: jiǎn dān shì jiǎn dān , jiù shì shǎo le shí jiān .
examples.en: It is simple, but it lacks the time.

examples.zh: 方便是方便，不过今天不合适。
examples.py: fāng biàn shì fāng biàn , bù guò jīn tiān bù hé shì .
examples.en: It is convenient, but unsuitable today.

commonMistakes.wrong: 好是好，所以完全没问题。
commonMistakes.right: 好是好，不过还有一个缺点。
commonMistakes.why: Here the concession prepares a reservation rather than a claim of perfection.

dialogue.title: A useful criticism
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the positive point, remaining issue and repair.

lines.zh: 计划好是好，不过地点还没确认。
lines.py: jì huà hǎo shì hǎo , bù guò dì diǎn hái méi què rèn .
lines.en: The plan is good, but the location is still unconfirmed.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 优点是时间清楚，缺点可以改。
lines.py: yōu diǎn shì shí jiān qīng chǔ , quē diǎn kě yǐ gǎi .
lines.en: Its strength is clear timing; the shortcoming can be corrected.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你说得太简单了，问题有点复杂。
lines.py: nǐ shuō dé tài jiǎn dān le , wèn tí yǒu diǎn fù zá .
lines.en: You explain it too simply; the issue is rather complex.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那先分开看。我不慌不忙地核对地址。
lines.py: nà xiān fēn kāi kàn . wǒ bù huāng bù máng de hé duì dì zhǐ .
lines.en: Then separate the issues; I will check the address unhurriedly.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 相比旧版，新版确实有优势，但不是完美。
lines.py: xiāng bǐ jiù bǎn , xīn bǎn què shí yǒu yōu shì , dàn bù shì wán měi .
lines.en: Compared with the old version, the new one has advantages but is not perfect.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 批评具体做法就好，别说谁都没用。
lines.py: pī píng jù tǐ zuò fǎ jiù hǎo , bié shuō shéi dōu méi yòng .
lines.en: Criticize the specific action, not call everyone useless.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对，面对问题不等于给整个人打分。
lines.py: duì , miàn duì wèn tí bù děng yú gěi zhěng gè rén dǎ fēn .
lines.en: Right; facing a problem does not mean scoring the whole person.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 确认以后再判断是否合格，先别说必然成功。
lines.py: què rèn yǐ hòu zài pàn duàn shì fǒu hé gé , xiān bié shuō bì rán chéng gōng .
lines.en: Judge against the standard after confirming; do not assert inevitable success.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这份计划简单是简单，就是地点信息还不可靠。
lines.py: zhè fèn jì huà jiǎn dān shì jiǎn dān , jiù shì dì diǎn xìn xī hái bù kě kào .
lines.en: The plan is simple, but its location information is unreliable.

lines.zh: 优点要保留，缺点要改，不论谁写，都不能把批评变成人身评价。
lines.py: yōu diǎn yào bǎo liú , quē diǎn yào gǎi , bù lùn shéi xiě , dōu bù néng bǎ pī píng biàn chéng rén shēn píng jià .
lines.en: Keep strengths and fix shortcomings; whoever wrote it, criticism should not become a judgment of the whole person.

lines.zh: 相比旧版，新版有优势，对核对时间有利，但复杂问题仍需分开。
lines.py: xiāng bǐ jiù bǎn , xīn bǎn yǒu yōu shì , duì hé duì shí jiān yǒu lì , dàn fù zá wèn tí réng xū fēn kāi .
lines.en: Compared with the old version, the new one has advantages and helps check time, but complex issues still need separating.

lines.zh: 合格按这次标准判断，完美和必然成功不是同一件事。
lines.py: hé gé àn zhè cì biāo zhǔn pàn duàn , wán měi hé bì rán chéng gōng bù shì tóng yī jiàn shì .
lines.en: Meeting the present standard differs from perfection or inevitable success.

lines.zh: 机器有毛病先查原因，面对困难可以求助；坚强也需要休息。
lines.py: jī qì yǒu máo bing xiān chá yuán yīn , miàn duì kùn nán kě yǐ qiú zhù ; jiān qiáng yě xū yào xiū xī .
lines.en: Check the cause of a machine fault; seek help with difficulties; resilient people also need rest.

lines.zh: 朋友脚痛，我们先听她说，不替她判断痛苦或命运。
lines.py: péng you jiǎo tòng , wǒ men xiān tīng tā shuō , bù tì tā pàn duàn tòng kǔ huò mìng yùn .
lines.en: The friend’s foot hurts; hear her account rather than judge her suffering or fate.

lines.zh: 她说药苦，只能说明味道，不能据此判断药效。
lines.py: tā shuō yào kǔ , zhǐ néng shuō míng wèi dào , bù néng jù cǐ pàn duàn yào xiào .
lines.en: Her report of bitter medicine describes taste, not evidence of effectiveness.

lines.zh: 互相帮助的精神值得尊重，精神力量也不能让不合格的信息自动变可靠。
lines.py: hù xiāng bāng zhù de jīng shén zhí de zūn zhòng , jīng shén lì liàng yě bù néng ràng bù hé gé de xìn xī zì dòng biàn kě kào .
lines.en: The spirit of mutual help deserves respect; mental strength cannot make deficient information reliable automatically.
